title: Which countries does Hikasus Travel operate in?
content: Hikasus Travel operates tours in Georgia, Armenia and Azerbaijan. You can travel in one country or combine two or all three in a longer Caucasus itinerary. We offer both private and group tours, with local guides throughout the journey.

title: Can I combine Georgia, Armenia and Azerbaijan in one trip?
content: Yes. Hikasus can arrange single-country tours as well as combined Caucasus itineraries. The exact route depends on your travel dates, trip length, passport and the current border and entry rules between the countries. Because border arrangements can change, we confirm the practical route before the trip rather than assuming every land crossing will be available.

title: What is the best time to travel to the Caucasus?
content: There is no single best month for every part of Georgia, Armenia and Azerbaijan, but spring and autumn are excellent for many cultural and nature-focused trips. April to June brings green landscapes and comfortable sightseeing weather, while September and October are especially good for food, wine, hiking and photography. Summer works well for the mountains and higher-altitude regions, while winter is suitable for selected ski and winter experiences.

title: Do I need a visa for Georgia, Armenia or Azerbaijan?
content: Visa requirements are different for each country and depend on your nationality and passport. Many travelers can visit Georgia and Armenia visa-free, while Azerbaijan requires an e-Visa for many nationalities that are not visa-free. Rules can change, so always check the requirements for your own passport before booking. Hikasus maintains separate Visa & Entry Requirements guides for Georgia, Armenia and Azerbaijan with more detailed information.

title: Can I travel between the Caucasus countries by land?
content: It depends on the countries, your nationality and the current border rules. Georgia and Armenia have established overland connections, while Azerbaijan's land-entry rules are different and can affect how a combined itinerary is routed. Some journeys may therefore require a flight rather than a road crossing. Hikasus checks the current official rules before confirming a cross-border itinerary.

title: What currencies are used in Georgia, Armenia and Azerbaijan?
content: Georgia uses the Georgian Lari (GEL), Armenia uses the Armenian Dram (AMD), and Azerbaijan uses the Azerbaijani Manat (AZN). Each country has its own currency, so you will normally change or withdraw money when crossing between them.

title: Can I pay by card or should I carry cash?
content: Cards are widely accepted in hotels, restaurants and larger shops in major cities such as Tbilisi, Yerevan and Baku. Cash is still useful in villages, markets, family-run businesses and more remote areas. ATMs are widely available in the main towns and cities, so carrying a combination of card and some local cash is usually the most practical approach.

title: What languages are spoken during Hikasus tours?
content: Hikasus tours run with local guides. English-speaking guides are available throughout Georgia, Armenia and Azerbaijan, and other guide languages may be available on request depending on the destination and dates. For private tours, confirm your preferred guide language when making your enquiry.

title: What types of tours does Hikasus Travel offer?
content: Hikasus offers private and group tours in Georgia, Armenia and Azerbaijan, as well as combined Caucasus itineraries. Trips can focus on culture and history, food and wine, mountains and nature, hiking and adventure, or a combination of these. Private tours can be adapted to your dates, preferred route and trip length. See our Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan and combined Caucasus tours.

title: How long can a private tour be?
content: Private tours are flexible in length. You can choose a short city or regional trip, a one-week journey, or a longer itinerary covering several parts of Georgia, Armenia and Azerbaijan. For combined Caucasus trips, allowing more time usually creates a better pace and reduces unnecessary long travel days.

title: What is normally included in a Hikasus tour?
content: Inclusions depend on the individual tour, but packages can include accommodation, private or group transportation, a local guide or driver-guide, airport transfers, selected entrance fees, meals, wine tastings and other activities. Always check the specific tour page for the exact list of what is included and not included.

title: What kind of transportation is used?
content: Vehicle type depends on the itinerary and number of travelers. Hikasus uses suitable cars, minivans, minibuses and larger vehicles for different group sizes and routes. Mountain and remote-area itineraries may require a different vehicle from city and highway touring. For combined-country trips, transport arrangements can also vary depending on current border requirements.

title: What kind of accommodation does Hikasus use?
content: Tour pages show the hotel options planned for each accommodation category. Depending on the itinerary, these can range from comfortable Classic and Mid-Range hotels to Premium properties, as well as selected guesthouses or mountain accommodation where they suit the route better. Private tours can often be adjusted if you prefer a different accommodation level.

title: Can Hikasus arrange airport transfers?
content: Yes. Airport transfers can be included as part of a tour, and Hikasus also offers transfer and shuttle services for selected routes — see our Shuttle Service. The exact service depends on your arrival airport, destination and itinerary.

title: Can vegetarian or other dietary requirements be accommodated?
content: Yes, many dietary requirements can be accommodated when we know about them in advance. Vegetarian meals are widely available, and we can discuss allergies or other dietary needs with hotels, restaurants and local hosts during planning. Please tell us about important dietary requirements when booking so we can check each part of the itinerary.

title: Are Hikasus tours suitable for different fitness levels?
content: Yes. Hikasus offers everything from relaxed cultural touring to mountain hikes and more active adventure trips. Each itinerary should be matched to the traveler's preferred pace and fitness level. For private tours, activities can often be adjusted, and demanding hikes or high-altitude excursions should always be discussed before booking.

title: Do you offer private tours as well as scheduled group tours?
content: Yes. Private trips are designed around your own travel dates, route and trip length, while scheduled group tours operate on fixed departure dates and follow the published program. Check the individual tour page for availability, group size and what is included.

title: How do I choose between a single-country tour and a combined Caucasus trip?
content: Choose a single-country tour if you want to explore one destination in greater depth and travel at a slower pace. A combined Caucasus trip is a good option if you have more time and want to experience the contrasts between Georgia, Armenia and Azerbaijan in one journey. Hikasus can help balance the route so the trip does not become a series of long transfers.
